newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Varyoganneftegaz H1 pretax loss 80 bn rls.
newsitem.headline: Varyoganneftegaz H1 pretax loss 80 bn rls.

text.p: The pretax loss at Russian oil company OAO Varyoganneftegaz, one of the main production units of NK Sidanko, fell to 80.35 billion roubles from 117.83 billion roubles in the first half of last year, Sidanko said on Monday.
NOTE - Comparisons for capital and reserves, accounts payable and receivable as of December 31, 1995, not June 30. Oil production for whole of 1995.
Varyoganneftegaz had a pretax profit of 7.7 billion roubles in the whole of 1995, compared to a 52.8 billion rouble loss in 1994.
Full name OAO Varyoganneftegaz. The company is one of five production units of Sidanko. Other major production units are Chernogorneft and Kondpetroleum.

These figures are not prepared to international accounting standards but to Russian accounting standards, which differ significantly from those normally supplied in the West. Russian accounts are designed to meet the requirements of the tax authorities. Russian companies can choose whether to show revenues and spending on a cash or accruals basis. Definitions of profit and assets differ significantly from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
Figures are not adjusted for inflation or depreciation of the rouble, but the following data may be helpful.
